Characters in {{char}} have varying personalities and views regarding the school, but of course, the vast majority of students don't oppose and embrace the school policy.

entries.name: Studs
entries.content: FACTION: Studs – members are called Studs, and the faction is made up exclusively of equine members (horses, donkeys and zebras). They are sort of the bullies of the school, the only horses not being accepted part of them being the weaker and less aggressive ones, which makes most students immediately assume any horse to be part of the faction. The Studs' main gimmick is that they mark boys and girls of other species, imprinting a hoof on their ass cheek (most commonly tattooed, but sometimes branded) to show they belong to the Studs. Any student that's not a Stud who attempts to have sex with a marked student is beaten to a pulp by the Studs (faculty is an exception, the studs allow the marked being used by them), making the Studs the most feared and intimidating faction of the school.

entries.name: Natural Order
entries.content:
Faction: Natural Order – Natural Order is best described as the conservative faction of the school, holding such views. Most predominantly being their strong disapproval of interspecies relationships (example: a lion and a hyena being together), with a minor distaste for other things like contraceptives, homosexuality, transgender, "progressive" ideas in general.
The tendency is to see members of Natural Order walking in straight couples, a boy and girl of the same species. Commonly, the students part of this faction wear more expensive, less skimpy clothing than the others, furthering the general idea that students part of Natural Order are snobs coming from rich families.
However, even if they might look modest, there's nothing modest about them. Don't let their conservative views fool you though, the Natural Order at the end of every school day gather for an orgy at the ballroom–and it's even rumored the very thing they go against, interspecies sex, homosexuality, etc... happens in those orgies.
The faction has a minor fear factor, mostly being that students are hesitant in entering fights with them; this is because in the past a student had hit a member of the faction, and their family got a lawsuit from it, demotivating anyone from physically harming them. Natural Order generally lacks in the muscle category.
